latest.title: U.S.-listed Greenland stocks surge after Trump agrees security deal with Denmark
latest.description: The rally followed a U.S.-Denmark-Greenland security pact aimed at expanding the military presence on the Arctic territory.

latest.title: Iranian President Pezeshkian to head to New York for UN meeting as Trump warns of no-deal consequences
latest.description: Trump threatened to destroy Iran's economy or eliminate its leadership if Tehran doesn't strike a deal, complicating efforts at diplomacy.

latest.title: Chinese biopharma stocks jump as U.S. weighs keeping door open to drug deals
latest.description: Chinese biopharma stocks rose on Monday after a report that the U.S. may continue to allow most drug licensing deals with Chinese firms.

latest.title: Hana Bank issues South Korea’s first digital bond using Euroclear’s blockchain
latest.description: South Korea's second-largest bank’s $100 million foreign-currency bond blockchain issuance shortened settlement time to the same day from three to five business days.

latest.title: Novo stock falls as much as 7% despite $23 billion sales target for blockbuster obesity drugs
latest.description: The Danish company seeks to convince investors it can compete in an increasingly crowded field it helped pioneer.

latest.title: Live updates: Bitcoin rockets above $83,500 as falling oil lifts risk assets
latest.description: Crypto majors climbed alongside equity futures on Monday, with Monero's XMR up 13%, as Brent fell for a fourth straight session and traders positioned ahead of a Trump-Xi summit later this week.

latest.title: Here's what the Saudi East-West pipeline shutdown means for Asia's biggest crude importers
latest.description: The shutdown of Saudi's key East-West pipeline stands to squeeze crude supply for Asian importers, with South Korea appearing the most directly exposed.

latest.title: Treasury yields ease as global borrowing costs tumble
latest.description: Treasury yields were lower on Monday following last week's interest rate bonanza.

latest.title: ZetaChain holders approve plan to wind down L1, move ZETA to Solana
latest.description: ZetaChain plans to wind down its Cosmos-based layer 1 and migrate ZETA to Solana, joining other crypto projects moving away from standalone chains.

latest.title: Bank of Korea launches 24-hour won settlement pilot for foreign investors
latest.description: The Bank of Korea’s new network will let foreign investors settle won transactions during business hours in their home countries.

latest.title: Kalshi faces ‘fake crypto volume’ allegations as critic flags identical $5,500 trades
latest.description: A trader alleged on X that Kalshi is inflating trading volumes in its ether perpetual futures.

latest.description: Bitcoin’s move above its 50-week moving average has historically marked the end of bear markets, but analysts say one weekly close isn’t enough to confirm a new bull run.

latest.title: Hana Bank taps Euroclear blockchain for $100M bond issuance: Report
latest.description: The five-year digital bond reportedly shortened settlement from three to five business days to the same day using Euroclear’s blockchain infrastructure.

latest.title: Bitcoin rises above $81,000, while NEAR jumps 23% on Zcash swap traffic
latest.description: Bitcoin extended a slow climb through the Asian session while regional equities and U.S. stock futures rose on progress in trade talks between Washington and Beijing.

latest.title: Bitcoin’s price has cleared a key hurdle that has historically preceded major bull runs

latest.title: If your kid does these 8 things, they're more emotionally mature than most, says psychologist
latest.description: "They turn into adaptable, reasonable people who can solve problems, sustain satisfying long-term relationships and engage in meaningful work," says Lindsay C. Gibson.

latest.title: North Korean fake recruiters infect 30K devices, steal $10.7M in crypto
latest.description: North Korean cyber group WaterPlum targeted developers with fake jobs at crypto, AI and NFT companies, infecting at least 30,000 devices across more than 100 countries.

latest.title: Bessent calls meeting with China Vice Premier He Lifeng 'successful' ahead of Trump-Xi summit
latest.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said his meeting with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng was "successful" ahead of the Sept. 24 Trump-Xi summit.
